Count documents in the vault — grouped or total — with the find filter surface

USAGE
    norn count [OPTIONS]

COUNT OPTIONS
        --by <FIELD1,FIELD2,...>
        Frontmatter field(s) to group document counts by, comma-separated. One field emits a flat distribution; several nest in order (e.g. --by project,lifecycle). Without --by, emits only the total

FILTER OPTIONS
        --text <NEEDLE>
        Full-text body substring. Case-insensitive. Empty string is a no-op

        --eq <FIELD:VALUE>
        Frontmatter equality predicate `field:value`. JSON-typed. An unknown `--field value` filters as `--eq field:value` for fields this vault knows

        --not-eq <FIELD:VALUE>
        Frontmatter `field` is NOT equal to `value`

        --in <FIELD:V1,V2,...>
        Frontmatter `field` is one of the comma-separated values (ANY-of)

        --not-in <FIELD:V1,V2,...>
        Frontmatter `field` is NOT one of the comma-separated values

        --starts-with <FIELD:VALUE>
        Frontmatter `field` (or any array element) starts with `VALUE`. Case-sensitive

        --ends-with <FIELD:VALUE>
        Frontmatter `field` (or any array element) ends with `VALUE`. Case-sensitive

        --contains <FIELD:VALUE>
        Frontmatter `field` (or any array element) contains `VALUE`. Case-sensitive

        --has <FIELD>
        Frontmatter `field` is present (non-null)

        --missing <FIELD>
        Frontmatter `field` is absent or null

        --before <FIELD:DATE>
        Frontmatter `field` (a date) is before `DATE`. ISO 8601 expected

        --after <FIELD:DATE>
        Frontmatter `field` (a date) is after `DATE`

        --on <FIELD:DATE>
        Frontmatter `field` (a date) is exactly `DATE`. Accepts `today`

        --path <GLOB>
        Path glob pattern

        --links-to <TARGET>
        Documents whose outgoing links resolve to TARGET (path, stem, or `[[wikilink]]`). Repeatable; multiple targets are AND'd. Resolved-only — TARGET must resolve to an existing document

        --unresolved-links
        Documents with at least one unresolved link
        Possible values: true, false

OUTPUT
        --format <FORMAT>
        Output format. Default records (records-block)
        Possible values: records, json

EXAMPLES
    norn count
        # total document count in the vault

    norn count --eq type:note --by status
        # notes only, grouped by status

    norn count --path 'Workspaces/**/tasks/*.md' --by status
        # one project's tasks, grouped by status

GLOBAL OPTIONS
    -C, --cwd <CWD>         Run as if norn started in this directory (default: $NORN_ROOT, else the current directory)
        --verbose           Include full diagnostic detail in output
        --no-cache-refresh  Skip the implicit cache refresh before reading the graph
        --color <COLOR>     Color output. Honors NO_COLOR / CLICOLOR_FORCE.
        --vault <NAME>      Target the registered vault with this name (see `norn vault register`)

Documentation: https://github.com/dbtlr/norn
